notes: Randomised PvP arena pool (CireArenas, Docs/Arenas.md). Written by Tools/AuthorArenas.py - edit that script, not this file. All arenas share the footprint at 'origin'; arena-local X runs from Ember (west) to Dusk (east). Piece rows: [slot, x, y, z, yaw, scaleX, scaleY, scaleZ, blocker]. Blockers get an invisible collision proxy matching the slot footprint and must be mirror-symmetric; slots list candidates in priority order (Fab packs, then CC0/original, then an engine shape).

arenas.name: The Sunlit Fields
arenas.theme: Golden wheat field at harvest, golden hour
arenas.subtitle: A harvest field at golden hour. Bales, stooks and the old wagon break the sightlines.

arenas.name: The Black Shore
arenas.theme: Icelandic black-sand beach: basalt columns, moss-covered lava, sea mist
arenas.subtitle: Black sand, basalt columns and mossy lava under a North Atlantic overcast.

arenas.name: Redrock Canyon
arenas.theme: Moab desert: red sandstone canyon, natural arch, harsh sun
arenas.subtitle: A red sandstone canyon under a hard desert sun. Fight beneath the arch.

arenas.name: Hornbeam Glade
arenas.theme: European hornbeam forest clearing, dappled light
arenas.subtitle: A clearing in the hornbeam wood. Fallen trunks and old roots hide the flanks.

arenas.name: The Drowned Sanctum
arenas.theme: A sunken temple on the seabed: caustics, kelp and drifting motes
arenas.subtitle: A temple lost beneath the sea. Columns and arches break the sightlines; kelp sways overhead.

arenas.name: Star Station Hangar
arenas.theme: An orbital hangar deck above a blue planet
arenas.subtitle: Hangar Bay 7, high above a blue world. Cargo and dropships are your cover.
